quranArabic.rights: Verbatim redistribution is permitted with attribution; the Quran text is not modified.

quranMeal.rights: QuranEnc permits translations to be downloaded and republished unchanged when publisher/source, version and transcript information are retained. Build metadata stores the current version response.

tafsir.work: Hak Dini Kur'an Dili — Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
tafsir.note: Original author died in 1942; this build keeps the digital transcription unchanged and records its repository provenance.

quranAudio.delivery: Verse audio is streamed on demand and can be saved by the user for offline listening.

prayerCalculation: Adhan calculation algorithm. Turkey approximation uses the app's documented Turkey parameters and is never presented as an official Diyanet API feed.
policy: Religious learning entries show sources and madhhab differences. Personal fatwa cases are directed to a qualified authority. Unknown claims are not authenticated merely because they resemble a religious quote.
